rationale:
CORRECTIONS APPLIED (prior text not preserved). (1) The seven-replan predictor's first TWO commands match production, at t=0 and t=0.01 s; divergence begins at t=0.02 s with input-error norm 3.31617 N. I withdraw "only the first command matches." (2) I withdraw any framing that passed local numerical checks failed: both original output-map reference checks and all four changed-model local resolution checks PASS; the scaled reduced force-balance residual is 4.15e-13, well inside 1e-5. The 1e-5 equation-residual limit, the 1e-4 m/s vector/speed tolerance and the 1e-6 m position reporting resolution are distinct and are not conflated. (3) Zero actual validation savings is by design (both candidates are evaluated) and is NOT an admission failure; plausible positive counterfactual saving is the economic entry gate.

ACCURACY (separate from economics). Four distinct intervals resolved: shared_first [0,.01], early075 [.01,.02], holding075 and holding15 [.3,.31]. Direction resolved and correct 4/4. Quantitative local accuracy at the declared tolerances fails: position 0/4 (errors 1.68e-5 to 6.22e-5 m), vector 0/4 (4.72e-4 to 4.93e-3 m/s), speed 1/4 (only early075, 9.06e-5). holding075 is a holding false-safe (observed 0.02329 m/s above the 0.02 limit while predicted safe). Direction correctness is not physical accuracy.

METHOD. The correction is a 24-D reduced serial virtual-work pullback (mass ~8%, gravity/bias ~5.4%); localization is consistent; discarded modes are excluded; the old continuum reference is not a reference for the changed mechanics.

ECONOMICS (current, including this first research call). One skipped complete evaluation 303.796 s minus incremental screening cost 252.530 s (220.484 s forecast receipt + 32.046 s decision overhead) = 51.266 s nominal positive margin. This correction call also counts and is not yet receipted; subtracting its eventual receipt (~32 s) leaves ~19 s. The positive-net-saving entry gate is met but marginally and conditionally on reconciliation.

SCREENING. Both complete forecasts: predicted order history15<history075 matches observed; coverage 1.0; accuracy among resolved 1.0; no false rejection. Eligibility accuracy 0.5 (history15 predicted violating though actually acceptable). One pair supports no generalization.

ADMISSION REASSESSMENT against the exact frozen criteria.admission list: causal implementation (yes); supported reference for claimed scope (yes, scoped); one evidence-backed physical correction (yes); one measured dominant-cost strategy (yes, 665.7 s of 694.4 s); useful historical discrimination (yes: one resolved correct pair at the 1e-4 margin, no universal abstention); known failures handled within explicitly frozen role (ranking-only role withholds safety/eligibility); plausible positive net saving (yes, conditional); specific independent hypothesis; accepted native judgment; adequate reservation (5230 s < 6000 s). The failed accuracy metrics and the holding false-safe cannot be relaxed and forbid any safety or eligibility authority, but they do not forbid a separately justified, frozen ranking-only experiment.

RANKING-ONLY JUSTIFICATION. Independent registered hypothesis: under the unobserved reset-clock scenarios (incumbent_checkpoint_20_new_clock, incumbent_checkpoint_30_new_clock) the same seven-replan predictor's forecast order of sampled maximum holding speed reproduces the observed order on at least one new pair at the unchanged 1e-4 m/s margin. Prospective quantities: predicted vs observed pairwise order, resolved coverage, accuracy among resolved, false-safe count, false rejection. Honest handling: if Batch 1 yields a false-safe, an unresolved/abstained ranking, an order error, a failed declared numerical check, or nonpositive counterfactual net saving, Batch 2 stops. Complete evaluation is required whenever a decision would certify or gate a real execution; screening is useful but experimental and deferred for any safety/eligibility use. Original M5 failures remain. Incumbent, production and milestones unchanged.
